\begin{minipage}[t]{0.49\linewidth}
\begin{tabular}[t]{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.31\linewidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.67\linewidth}@{}}
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textcolor[HTML]{3C5A99}{\textbf{Robot data}}}\\[1pt]
\textbf{Episode / session} & one demonstration; episodes recorded consecutively at one site \\
\textbf{End-effector} & the tool at the arm's tip, a two-finger gripper \\
\textbf{Action block} & all commands of one model step, concatenated \\
\addlinespace[2pt]
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textcolor[HTML]{9C4F6B}{\textbf{Surgical data}}}\\[1pt]
\textbf{Practice task} & a standard surgeon exercise, e.g. peg transfer \\
\textbf{Phantom} & an artificial practice model of tissue \\
\textbf{dVRK} & da Vinci Research Kit, a surgical robot \\
\textbf{Scene camera} & an external camera, not an endoscope \\
\addlinespace[2pt]
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textcolor[HTML]{8A6D1E}{\textbf{Simulated plug-in}}}\\[1pt]
\textbf{Latent error} & one-step feature error given true past features \\
\addlinespace[2pt]
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textcolor[HTML]{4A5568}{\textbf{Baselines}}}\\[1pt]
\textbf{Direct} & regresses each future grid as $\mathbf{Z}_0$ + residual \\
\textbf{AR} & residual to the latest grid, rolled out recursively \\
\textbf{AR-TF} & DINO-WM-style: teacher-forced next step, rolled out \\
\end{tabular}
\end{minipage}\hfill
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.49\linewidth}
\begin{tabular}[t]{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.31\linewidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.67\linewidth}@{}}
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textcolor[HTML]{009E73}{\textbf{ShiftWM}}}\\[1pt]
\textbf{Patch features} & frozen DINOv2 $16{\times}16$ grid \\
\textbf{Transport window} & $w{\times}w$ patches in the last $S$ frames \\
\textbf{Transport} & content moved from observed patches \\
\textbf{Correction} & added residual for new content \\
\textbf{Gate} & per-patch weight: keep vs. move \\
\textbf{Oracle move} & observed feature closest to the truth \\
\addlinespace[2pt]
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textcolor[HTML]{00785A}{\textbf{Evaluation}}}\\[1pt]
\textbf{Persistence} & copy the last observed grid \\
\textbf{Rollout} & own predictions fed back as inputs \\
\textbf{Moving patches} & 25\% with the largest true change \\
\textbf{Teacher forcing} & train on true past, not own output \\
\textbf{Skill} & share of persistence error removed \\
\textbf{Session split} & no recording session in two splits \\
\addlinespace[2pt]
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textcolor[HTML]{243447}{\textbf{Other}}}\\[1pt]
\textbf{Window, horizon} & $H{=}3$ observed and $K{=}10$ future steps; $k$ steps ahead \\
\textbf{Open / closed loop} & forecasting without new observations / re-planning after each chunk \\
\textbf{Success} & the final state is within the task's tolerance of the goal \\
\textbf{Proprioception} & the robot's measured joint and gripper state \\
\textbf{Ex vivo} & tissue removed from the body \\
\end{tabular}
\end{minipage}}
